description: This Java class 'ZonesLoader' loads geographic zone data from a JSON file, mapping zones to countries and languages, and handling descriptions and duplicates.

classes.name: ZonesLoader
classes.description: A component responsible for loading zone data from a JSON resource, associating zones with countries and languages, and handling descriptions.

methods.name: loadZones
methods.description: Loads zones from a JSON file specified by path, constructing a map of zones with descriptions across different languages and associating each zone with a country.
